# doit_composer_recipes (Data Source)

Beta. Read-only access to Composer recipes and their results. A recipe evaluates your cloud resources against a set of conditions; each result is a finding on one affected resource, and published recipes surface as proprietary Insights in the Console.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve all Composer recipes
data "doit_composer_recipes" "all" {}

# Filter recipes with active results and sort by severity
data "doit_composer_recipes" "active" {
  filter     = "has_active_results:true"
  sort_by    = "severity"
  sort_order = "desc"
}

output "total_recipes" {
  value = data.doit_composer_recipes.all.row_count
}

output "active_recipe_summaries" {
  value = [for r in data.doit_composer_recipes.active.items : {
    id                   = r.id
    title                = r.title
    provider             = r.provider
    severity             = r.severity
    active_results_count = r.active_results_count
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Restricts the recipes returned. One string of `key:value` clauses: `,` separates alternative values for one key (OR) and `|` separates keys (AND). For example, `severity:critical,high|provider:aws,gcp` returns recipes whose severity is critical or high and whose provider is Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform. Because `,` and `|` are separators, a value itself can't contain them. Only equality matching is supported. Omit `filter` to list every recipe that has results in your recently scanned accounts, including dismissed recipes.

Keys:
- `provider`: one or more of `aws`, `azure`, `azure_ad`, `gcp`, `general`, `google_cloud_source`, `google_workspace`, `k8s`, `oci`, `vmware`.
- `severity`: one or more of `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`.
- `pillar`: one or more of `cost`, `operations`, `performance`, `security`, `compliance`. Matches recipes tagged with that pillar; `compliance` matches recipes tagged with at least one compliance standard (such as SOC2 or HIPAA).
- `has_active_results`: exactly one of `true` or `false`.
- `allocation`: up to 10 distinct allocation IDs (duplicates are ignored); get allocation IDs from `GET /analytics/v1/allocations`. Matches recipes with results on resources in any of those allocations, as resolved by Cloud Analytics; counts, savings and `rowCount` then cover only those resources. You must be able to view every listed allocation. Service-account API keys can use public allocations only. If allocation access can't be checked, the request returns `503` with `Retry-After` and never falls back to unfiltered data.

Errors:
- An unknown key returns `400 filter_key_not_supported` when it's the only problem, otherwise `400 validation_failed`.
- A value outside the allowed list, a non-boolean `has_active_results`, more than one `has_active_results` value, more than 10 distinct allocation IDs, an invalid allocation ID (blank, longer than 256 characters, or containing `/`, whitespace or control characters), a malformed expression or an unsupported operator returns `400 validation_failed`.
- An allocation that doesn't exist or that you can't view returns `404 composer-api.allocation_not_found`.
- `max_results` (Number) Maximum number of items to return on one page, from 1 to 500. Defaults to 50. A value outside that range returns `400 validation_failed`.
- `page_token` (String) Continuation token from the `pageToken` of the previous response. Omit it on the first request; a response without `pageToken` is the last page.

The token records the position, the sort and the `allocation` filter IDs. Changing `sortBy`, `sortOrder` or the allocation IDs while paginating returns `400 pagination_token_invalid`. Keep the other `filter` keys and `maxResults` unchanged while paginating. Tokens expire 5 minutes after they are issued; an expired token returns `400 pagination_token_expired`. In both cases, restart from the first page.
- `sort_by` (String) Field to sort recipes by. Defaults to `severity`. Ties break by title (case-insensitive, ascending), then by `id` (ascending), whatever the `sortOrder`.
Possible values: `severity`, `title`, `detection_time`, `active_results_count`, `total_results_count`
- `sort_order` (String) Sort direction for `sortBy`. Defaults to `desc`.
Possible values: `asc`, `desc`
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Recipes on this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `row_count` (Number) Total number of recipes across all pages.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `active_results_count` (Number) Number of active results (not resolved and not snoozed). 0 when the recipe is dismissed.
- `affected_resource_type` (String) Type of cloud resource the recipe's findings are on. Absent when unknown.
- `description` (String) Longer explanation of what the recipe detects. Fetched on a best-effort basis, so it can be absent even when the recipe has one.
- `detection_time` (String) When the earliest of the recipe's results was first detected (RFC 3339, UTC). Absent when unavailable.
- `estimated_fix_time_minutes` (Number) Estimated time to fix one finding, in minutes. Absent when not estimated.
- `id` (Number) Recipe ID. Use it as `recipeId` to list the recipe's results.
- `is_dismissed` (Boolean) Whether the recipe has been dismissed for your customer.
- `metadata` (Attributes) Remediation guidance for the recipe. Always present; an empty object means no guidance is available. Each field is present only when the recipe has that content. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--metadata))
- `provider` (String) Cloud provider or platform, using the Console's provider names.
- `resolved_results_count` (Number) Number of resolved results. 0 when the recipe is dismissed.
- `severity` (String) Severity of the recipe's results, set by the recipe's author.
- `snoozed_results_count` (Number) Number of snoozed results. 0 when the recipe is dismissed.
- `status` (String) Recipe status, derived from its results and whether it is dismissed. Absent when unavailable.
- `title` (String) Recipe title, as shown in the Console.
- `total_potential_savings` (String) Potential cost savings across the recipe's active results, as a daily amount in US dollars. A decimal string with 2 decimal places (8 for amounts below 0.01), unlike the numeric per-result `costEstimationPotentialSavings`. When no active result has an estimate, it is the total recorded on the recipe's resolved results instead. The Console **Cost savings** column is this daily US-dollar amount × 365, converted to your organization's currency. Absent when not estimated.
- `total_results_count` (Number) Number of results in any status. 0 when the recipe is dismissed.

<a id="nestedatt--items--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `impacts` (String) Possible impact of applying the remediation.
- `important_points` (List of String) Points to consider before remediating.
- `manual_remediation` (String) HTML describing how to remediate the finding manually.
- `reference` (String) Documentation URL for the finding.
